summary: Build donor pipelines, funding plans, and stronger proposals with practical resource mobilisation training. Enrol to improve results fast.
lede: Resource mobilisation and fundraising strategy helps funding teams organize donor pipelines around program needs and funding gaps. For professionals who manage funding pipelines, proposals, donor relationships, or performance reporting, it develops skills in donor segmentation, prospecting, and strategy design. Participants also practice shaping concept notes with a logical framework, justifying budgets, planning donor stewardship, and tracking pipeline health through CRM workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage funding pipelines, write proposals, negotiate donor relationships, and report on resource mobilisation performance.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic experience in development work, nonprofit operations, fundraising support, grant administration, partnership coordination, or program delivery. A working understanding of organizational budgets and project objectives is helpful, and no coding is required. Prior exposure to proposal writing, donor reporting, or CRM-based donor tracking will make the exercises easier to apply, but it is not mandatory.
